Guide.comment: ElevenLabs premade 'Rachel' - warm coach voice. Swap voice_id to taste.

AXIOM.comment: 'AGEIS-7' (shared voice, saved in My Voices as AXIOM_AGEIS7) - unsettling AI. Runners-up also in My Voices: AXIOM_Elon, AXIOM_Hakan, AXIOM_Yucel, AXIOM_Sigma, AXIOM_Systemus.

lines.text: Pawns only go forward! Click the glowing square to move.
On your first step, you can sprint two squares!
Pawns capture diagonally! Zigzag through all the enemies!
Race to the top! The enemy pawn is coming toward you. Dodge it, or capture it!
lines.match: BOSS: Race to the top! The enemy pawn is coming toward you — dodge or capture it!

lines.text: You captured the enemy pawn! You win the race!
You won the race! You've mastered the pawn!
The enemy pawn reached the end! Try again. You can do it!
lines.match: The enemy pawn reached the end! Try again — you can do it!

lines.text: You did it! Pawns march forward, one step at a time!
You captured and conquered! Diagonal captures are your secret weapon!
Rooks slide in straight lines! Slide across to grab the orbs!
Up, down, left, right. As far as you want!
lines.match: Up, down, left, right — as far as you want!

lines.text: Rooks can't go through walls. Find another way!
lines.match: Rooks can't go through walls — find another way!

lines.text: You caught the runner! Straight lines, unstoppable!
The runner escaped! Try again. Trap it against the edge!
lines.match: The runner escaped! Try again — trap it against the edge!

lines.text: You found the way around! Nothing stops a clever rook!
Bishops only move diagonally! Stay on your color and grab the orbs!
Some orbs are on purple squares. I can't reach those, they're not my color!
lines.match: Some orbs are on purple squares — I can't reach those, they're not my color!

lines.text: A wall on your diagonal! Find another diagonal around it!
See? Bishops stay on one color forever. That's their secret!
You found another diagonal! Clever!
Knights move in an L. Two squares one way, one to the side! Hop to the stars!
lines.match: Knights move in an L — two squares one way, one to the side! Hop to the stars!

lines.text: You're walled in?! Not a problem. Knights jump over anything!
lines.match: You're walled in?! Not a problem — knights JUMP over anything!

lines.text: Follow the star trail! One L-hop at a time, like connect-the-dots!
lines.match: Follow the star trail! One L-hop at a time — like connect-the-dots!

lines.text: Tag! You got her! Nobody escapes a knight!
lines.match: TAG! You got her! Nobody escapes a knight!

lines.text: Luna got away! Try again. Cut off her escape routes!
lines.match: Luna got away! Try again — cut off her escape routes!

lines.text: See? Walls mean nothing to a knight!
lines.match: See? Walls mean NOTHING to a knight!

lines.text: Trail complete! You've mastered the L!
Move like Tara's rook! Slide straight and grab them all!
Now move like Zig's bishop! Slide diagonally!
Now use both! Straight and diagonal. You're unstoppable!
lines.match: Now use BOTH! Straight AND diagonal — you're unstoppable!

lines.text: Rows, columns, diagonals. The whole board is yours!
lines.match: Rows, columns, diagonals — the whole board is yours!

lines.text: You made it through without a single alarm. That's king discipline!
Alarm! Check! Back to safety!
lines.match: ALARM! CHECK! Back to safety!

lines.text: Check! The alarm rings. Next piece!
lines.match: CHECK! The alarm rings. Next piece!

lines.text: Now flip it: YOU give the check! Move your rook so its path hits AXIOM's king.
AXIOM blocks it. That's P, Protect!
AXIOM runs away. That's R, Run!
AXIOM has noticed you...
Five checks, and AXIOM escaped every single one.
Interesting. Remember this feeling, cadet.
No squares glow. Try clicking around. Is ANY square safe?
lines.match: ...no squares glow. Try clicking around. Is ANY square safe?

lines.text: Click your king first!
Hint: try the gold move! Click the gold rook, then the gold square.
lines.match: Hint: try the GOLD move! Click the gold rook, then the gold square.

lines.text: Click one of YOUR rooks first, then where it should go.
A rook only slides in straight lines. Pick a glowing square!
Click your piece first, then where it should go.
That square isn't reachable. Pick a glowing one!
You dodged the stalemate trap. AXIOM's firewall is next.
AXIOM is waiting in the core. Finish this.
lines.match: AXIOM is waiting in THE CORE. Finish this.

lines.text: That square isn't reachable! Look at the glowing squares.
Oops, no moves left! Let's try again. Remember: capture diagonally!
Amazing! You've mastered this piece!
Great job! Ready for the next challenge?
Your friends already hacked his army. His queen and a rook are gone!
Now finish it the only way that counts: checkmate.
Checkmate! AXIOM is defeated, and Neo City is free. You are a Chess Cadet! Thank you for playing!
So. The little cadet made it to my core.
My firewall has no weaknesses.
lines.match: AXIOM: "My firewall has no weaknesses."

lines.text: Alarms can't stop me!
...No safe squares?!
lines.match: AXIOM: "...no safe squares?!" Interesting. Remember this feeling, cadet.
